title: Authorities intercept P19.5-M in contraband cigarettes in Lanao del Sur

blocks.text: MARAWI CITY, Lanao del Sur – Police and military authorities intercepted contraband cigarettes worth some P19.5 million in separate operations in Lanao del Sur province on Friday, November 20. Colonel Caezar Cabuhat, Lanao del Sur police director, told the Inquirer that the first incident happened at past midnight on Friday when law enforcers raided a warehouse in Bara-as village of Picong town.
